title: RunSessionListResult
description: run.session-list-result@1 (the Desks plan's D6): GET /api/v1/sessions on OpenVibe.Run (capability run.session.read): the caller's own sessions, newest first, running ones by default (?state=ended or ?state=all for others), at most limit (default 20, at most 100) per page; next_cursor continues the list and is null on the last page.
